title: THE n-FAMILY SEARCH: is there ANY mu-family with n(a0) that reconciles the deep end and the full curves?

family.n2_member: g_obs^2 = g_N^2 + a0 g_N (the committed quadratic RAR, G071) at n = 2.000
family.deep: g_obs -> a0^(n/4) g_N^(1-n/4); deep slope 1 - n/4; a0_eff = a0^(n/2) g_N^(1-n/2)

wedge_restated.full_curve: n = 2.000 @ a0_DE (G071 registered rms 0.1454 dex, k = 0)

subluminality.standing: the reconciling family exits the framework's n <= 2 Padé bound

M2_a0z.statement: the G011 form raises a0 by ~2.2% over the MIGHTEE z-gap vs the ~55-90% the deep end demands; gamma free needs 12-32 vs the canonical 1

deciding.by: AICc/BIC on the pooled 747 points, unweighted dex, same residual definition

verdicts.V1: V1 THE RECONCILED FIT (n-free, pooled 747 points): n* = 2.070 +- 0.208, a0* = 1.341e-10 +- 1.16e-10, rms 0.1667 dex, BIC -2176.8.  The pair does NOT sit between the two ends (deep-end-alone n 2.212 / a0 1.045e-10, full-curve-alone SPARC n 2.025 / a0 1.385e-10): it exits the framework's n <= 2 subluminal family at +0.3 sigma and its deep-window slope 0.487 is +3.7 sigma from the measured 0.601+-0.031.  Residuals: SPARC 0.1573, MIGHTEE 0.1338, HI 0.3424; the MIGHTEE-deep mean stays -0.0465 dex (69% of the -0.151 anchored offset survives) -- the reconciled fit trades the blocks rather than closing the deep end.
verdicts.V3: V3 THE HONEST STATEMENT -- the wedge does NOT close under any candidate.  M1 (n-free): n* = 2.070 +- 0.208, a0* = 1.341e-10, rms 0.1667, BIC -2176.8 -- best of the three on the deciding statistic but OUTSIDE the framework family (+0.3 sigma above the n = 2.01 bound) and leaving MIGHTEE-deep -0.046 dex and the deep slope (+3.7 sigma) open.  M2a (G011 canonical gamma = 1): raises a0 by only 2.16% over the MIGHTEE z-gap vs the ~55-90% demanded (required gamma 12-32 vs 1; fitted gamma* 12), rms 0.1667, BIC -2182.9, d_BIC vs M1 -6.1 -- the G011 form is 12x too slow and leaves the z = 0 deep components (HI 1.447e-10) untouched.  M3 (environmental): G03D's registered test moved the free fit DOWN 1.414 -> 0.547 x a0_DE (wrong direction) and the LOWEST-EFE sample (HI field dwarfs) is the deep HIGH reader; rms 0.1659, d_BIC vs M1 -5.4; M2b and M3 are the same two-amplitude model (gamma* 12 <-> f 1.29).  THE NUMBER: the 3-model comparison resolves the wedge to the n-free reading at d_BIC = -6.1 (vs G011) and -5.4 (vs environmental) -- both decisive -- but the n-free reading itself fails the framework's own n <= 2 bound at +0.3 sigma and the deep-slope channel at +3.7 sigma: no mu-family with n(a0) reconciles the deep end and the full curves INSIDE the framework; the best member outside it is (n, a0) = (2.07+-0.21, 1.34e-10), and even it leaves the MIGHTEE deep mean at -0.046 dex.
verdicts.consequence: THE CONSEQUENCE: neither reading is decisive at BIC > 10; the honest split holds.
